decisions.decision: Fixed production service to launch dlp-drive-host only in real interactive console sessions.
decisions.rationale: Launching in session 0 left the drive invisible to the logged-on user; filtering WTS sessions to 'console' or a non-empty username places the host in session 1.

decisions.decision: Made the service resilient to configuration verifier and transport failures.
decisions.rationale: Offline enforcement is a must-have; a rejected verifier or unavailable transport must not stop the service loop.

decisions.decision: Added session-monitor health polling to relaunch the drive host after unexpected exit.
decisions.rationale: The ForcedTermination scenario requires the service to recover from host process death without manual intervention.

decisions.decision: Ran protected-drive verification commands via Register-ScheduledTask -LogonType Interactive.
decisions.rationale: PSRemoting sessions are session-specific and cannot see per-user mapped drives; the interactive console session can see P:.

decisions.decision: Set LAB-CLIENT01 auto-logon DefaultDomainName to lab.local.
decisions.rationale: Win32_ComputerSystem.Domain returns the DNS domain (lab.local), which must match the registry value for Test-AutoLogon to pass.
